title: CINet_v2 Neural-Physics Dual-Guidance Object Localization System
description: Sub-window continuous keypoint heatmap regression fused with satellite microphysical cold-top overshooting and rapid cooling centroids, with decaying anvil physical gating.

evaluation_protocol.gating_formula: Delta BT13 = BT13(T-10) - BT13(T-40) <= -1.0 K (reject if > -1.0 K)
evaluation_protocol.alpha_selection: alpha swept on dev only, then frozen per peak mode for benchmark/test

alpha_selection.note: benchmark and test are scored once at the dev-selected alpha; no sweep on evaluation splits
